name: Tailored Shirt
text: At each shop, you may pay 30 gold to choose a card. That card starts in your hand next round.

signature.effect: pay 30 gold, add a chosen created card

archetypes: High Card, Spade Master, Heart Chorus; splash Gold Miner, Nil Champion
decision: Whether 30 gold is worth more as a card next round or toward sigils, and which card to order (the ace of spades for tricks, a heart for Heart Chorus, a two for nil).
opponent: Hidden until the card is played.
aiNote: Pay from round 6 on, or earlier when gold would stay above 150 after buying; order the ace of spades, or a two when planning nil.
rationale: The chosen card is the real card from the deck: whoever was dealt it gets a random card of yours instead. Worth about a trick for 30 gold, a poor trade early and a good one late when gold buys little.
deviation: Revision 1: the real card starts in your hand instead of a created copy, so the hand stays at 13 cards.
